ranks: Need-keys Phase 2: cards freed by built keys (author-freed over --stale), with need-key themes step 1's probably-expressible keys (docs/plans/need-key-themes.md, 2026-11-07): cost reduction for spells cast from anywhere but your hand, energy you get, a counter removed, snow and legendary landwalk, hexproof from monocolored, until-end-of-combat P/T, linked exile returned under your control.

blocked.name: Primitive Justice
blocked.reason: '{1}{R} and/or {1}{G} any number of times': two repeatable additional costs, each adding a target, one adding 1 life; kicker can't say it (the record's cost:multiple-alternative-costs didn't cover it).

blocked.name: Chaotic Transformation
blocked.reason: a player who controlled several exiled permanents chooses which to reveal for first (the ruling); a fixed slot order chooses for them.

blocked.name: Over the Top
blocked.reason: each player's permanents must enter in one event (rule 603.6a); for-each-player's simultaneous around look-and-choose moves nothing.

blocked.name: Dream Harvest
blocked.reason: an until-end-of-turn free-cast permission over the cards reveal-until-count exiled.

blocked.name: Screeching Scorchbeast
blocked.reason: cards-milled is emitted per player; a simultaneous multi-player mill must trigger once with the total (the ruling).

blocked.name: Glowing One
blocked.reason: triggers once per nonland card milled (the ruling); mills has no perCard.

blocked.name: Infesting Radroach
blocked.reason: one trigger per nonland card an opponent mills.

blocked.name: Cass, Hand of Vengeance
blocked.reason: wasAttachedTo matches only objects on the battlefield, so the Aura cards in the graveyard can't be found.

blocked.name: The Ruinous Powers
blocked.reason: 'when you cast a spell this way, its owner loses life' tied to an until-end-of-turn permission; Kefka's byOwner reads only a cast-now.

blocked.name: Last Night Together
blocked.reason: additional-combat without afterThisPhase adds a main phase the card doesn't; onlyAttackers can't name the chosen targets.

blocked.name: Benthic Anomaly
blocked.reason: an untargeted choice per opponent, then a copy of one with the chosen creatures' total P/T, a colorless Eldrazi.

blocked.name: Corrupted Crossroads
blocked.reason: devoid is only empty colours here, so a devoid spell can't be told from another colorless spell (its ruling).

blocked.name: Ratchet, Field Medic // Ratchet, Rescue Racer
blocked.reason: 'when you do' must not fire after a convert rule 701.28e ignores (the ruling).

blocked.name: Watcher of Hours
blocked.reason: time-counter-removed has no amount or remover: it fires on anyone's removal, not per counter.

blocked.name: Flameskull
blocked.reason: the one-play group spans the top card and Flameskull itself; impulse-exile's upTo covers only what it exiled.
